videos.title: Drag a primitive
videos.desc: Drop a Box from the sidebar onto the workplane. That's it. Every shape works the same way.

videos.title: Live-scrub sliders
videos.desc: Drag any number slider in Properties. The shape morphs in real time, single undo step per scrub.

videos.title: Math in number fields
videos.desc: Type 2*12+4, sqrt(50), or max(10,8) into any size input. Evaluates on Enter.

videos.title: Chamfer + Fillet
videos.desc: Round any edge on Box, Cylinder, Cone, Polygon, Star, Heart, Wedge, Roof, Pyramid, Tube.

videos.title: Body-drag + snap
videos.desc: Drag a shape, the lime ring marks where it snapped (neighbour corner, midpoint, or centre).

videos.title: Group (union)
videos.desc: Select two solids, Ctrl+G, the result is a single CSG body. Reversible until Bake.

videos.title: Hole (subtract)
videos.desc: Mark a shape as Hole in Properties, group with a solid, the hole is carved.

videos.title: Intersect
videos.desc: Ctrl+Shift+G keeps only the volume common to all selected solids.

videos.title: Bake
videos.desc: Commit a CSG group to a flat mesh. Frees memory and locks the result.

videos.title: Ungroup
videos.desc: Restore the source parts of a CSG group, only works before Bake.

videos.title: Push / Pull axial face
videos.desc: Click a face of a Box, drag away, a new prism extrudes along the face normal.

videos.title: Push / Pull slanted face
videos.desc: Wedge slope or pyramid lateral, Push/Pull works on any face including 30 deg slants.

videos.title: Cut along an axis
videos.desc: Slice a shape on X, Y, or Z with a live plane preview.

videos.title: Hollow
videos.desc: Carve a shell with a chosen wall thickness.

videos.title: Array linear
videos.desc: Duplicate N copies along X, Y, or Z with a fixed spacing.

videos.title: Array circular
videos.desc: Spread N copies around an axis at a total angle. Source offset from origin gives the radius.

videos.title: Array Skip instances
videos.desc: Type 3, 7, 9 into Skip, those copies drop out of the pattern. Hex grids with gaps in one step.

videos.title: Workplane on a face
videos.desc: Click any face, new shapes spawn aligned to it instead of Z=0.

videos.title: Resize handles
videos.desc: Drag a white face square to resize on one axis.

videos.title: Symmetric resize (Alt)
videos.desc: Hold Alt while dragging a face handle, both opposite faces move out together.

videos.title: Uniform resize (Shift)
videos.desc: Hold Shift, all three axes scale proportionally.

videos.title: Reference plane (3 points)
videos.desc: Click 3 points on any shapes, a translucent cyan plane appears through them.

videos.title: Reference axis (along edge)
videos.desc: Click any feature edge, a dashed cyan axis line appears aligned with it.

videos.title: Midpoint marker
videos.desc: Click any edge, a marker drops at its midpoint, handy for centring.

videos.title: Snap to references
videos.desc: Body-drag and resize handles snap to ref planes, axes, and midpoints.

videos.title: Use a plane as workplane
videos.desc: House icon on a PLANE_3P row in the Outliner makes that plane the active workplane in one click.

videos.title: Extrude a polygon
videos.desc: Click polygon corners on the workplane, Enter, the profile extrudes into a prism.

videos.title: Scribble a freehand outline
videos.desc: Hold left-click and drag to draw, release, the outline closes and extrudes.

videos.title: Revolve a lathe profile
videos.desc: Click points to draw a 2D profile (X=radius, Y=height), Enter, the profile spins into a solid.

videos.title: Dimension overlay
videos.desc: Select any shape, X / Y / Z size labels appear at the bounding-box edges in the active unit.

videos.title: Edge-hover dimensions
videos.desc: Cursor near any feature edge shows the edge's exact length, hidden diagonals are filtered out.

videos.title: Ruler tool
videos.desc: 2-point distance measurement with per-axis delta and vertex snap.

videos.title: Rotate gizmo (R)
videos.desc: Press R to summon the rotation arcs, drag an arc to spin.

videos.title: Rotation snap
videos.desc: With snap step 15 deg, rotation locks to neat angles, Ctrl bypasses.

videos.title: Scale gizmo (S)
videos.desc: Press S, drag a handle to scale uniformly or per-axis.

videos.title: Duplicate (Ctrl+D)
videos.desc: Copy the selection in place, offset slightly.

videos.title: Delete
videos.desc: Delete key removes the selection, undo restores.

videos.title: Hide / Show
videos.desc: Toggle the eye in the Outliner, the shape stays in the project but vanishes from the viewport.

videos.title: Lock
videos.desc: Locked shapes are visible but ignore clicks and drags.

videos.title: Reset transform
videos.desc: Reset position, rotation, and scale to defaults in one click.

videos.title: Drop to ground (D)
videos.desc: Snap the bottom of the bounding box to Z=0, the shape lands on the workplane.

videos.title: Align
videos.desc: Centre or edge-align two or more selected shapes on any axis.

videos.title: Mirror
videos.desc: Flip the selection on X, Y, or Z.

videos.title: Export STL
videos.desc: STL button writes a watertight ASCII or binary STL ready for the slicer.

videos.title: Export OBJ
videos.desc: OBJ export with material groups, useful for the renderer pipeline.

videos.title: Export STEP
videos.desc: STEP AP203 faceted-brep, imports as a mesh body into Fusion, Onshape, SolidWorks.

videos.title: Save project (Ctrl+S)
videos.desc: Saves a .json with every shape, ref, workplane override, and unit choice.

videos.title: Load project
videos.desc: Reopens a .json, shapes plus reference geometry restored as-is.

videos.title: Import STL or OBJ
videos.desc: Drag a file onto the viewport, auto-repair fixes weld and degenerate triangles.

videos.title: Screenshot
videos.desc: PNG of the viewport at the current quality preset.

videos.title: Click to select
videos.desc: Tap a shape to make it the active selection.

videos.title: Shift multi-select
videos.desc: Hold Shift while clicking to add or remove shapes from the selection.

videos.title: Marquee drag
videos.desc: Drag on empty space to draw a selection rectangle, everything inside is picked.

videos.title: Select all (Ctrl+A)
videos.desc: Selects every visible shape in one keystroke.

videos.title: Outliner rename
videos.desc: Double-click a name in the Outliner to edit. Helps when the scene has 30+ shapes.

videos.title: Outliner hide-eye
videos.desc: Per-row eye icon toggles visibility without affecting selection.

videos.title: Reference geometry list
videos.desc: Outliner has a dedicated 'Reference geometry' section for planes, axes, and midpoints.

videos.title: View shortcuts (1, 3, 7, 0)
videos.desc: Front, Right, Top, and Iso views are one keypress away.

videos.title: ViewCube
videos.desc: Click any face, edge, or corner of the cube widget, the camera animates to that angle.

videos.title: Frame selection (F)
videos.desc: Centres the camera and zooms to fit the current selection.

videos.title: Orthographic toggle (P)
videos.desc: Switch between perspective and orthographic. Ortho is better for measuring and alignment.

videos.title: Undo / Redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z)
videos.desc: 50-step history. One scrub of a slider counts as one history slot.

videos.title: Shortcuts palette (Ctrl+K)
videos.desc: Searchable modal listing every keyboard shortcut. Esc closes.

videos.title: Quickstart empty state
videos.desc: First launch or empty scene shows a 4-step numbered walkthrough.

videos.title: Toast notifications
videos.desc: Non-blocking bottom-right toasts for save / export / errors. Auto-dismiss.

videos.title: Tooltips everywhere
videos.desc: Every toolbar button has an explanation on hover. Disable in Settings if they get in the way.

videos.title: Settings panel
videos.desc: Theme, viewport background, quality preset, snap step, unit, tooltips, licence.

videos.title: Dark / light theme
videos.desc: One toggle swaps the whole UI.

videos.title: Unit picker (mm / cm / inch)
videos.desc: Pick once on first launch, change anytime, all properties relabel.

videos.title: Quality preset (Fast / Balanced / Sharp)
videos.desc: Trade GPU load for sharpness. Useful on integrated graphics.

videos.title: Memory indicator
videos.desc: Topbar pill shows JS heap usage. Watch the MB figure, not the percentage.

videos.title: Tablet rail UI
videos.desc: On iPad and Android tablets, a floating left rail holds the primary tools.

videos.title: Tablet props card
videos.desc: Properties slide in as a floating card on the right when a shape is selected.

videos.title: Phone bottom dock
videos.desc: Six large icons (Insert, Undo, Group, Edit, Help, More) along the bottom.

videos.title: Phone Insert sheet
videos.desc: Tap the + icon, the shape library slides up as a bottom-sheet. Tap a primitive to spawn.

videos.title: Phone Edit sheet
videos.desc: Tap Edit, the Properties bottom-sheet appears with full sliders, touch-friendly thumbs.

videos.title: More menu on phone
videos.desc: Every secondary tool sectioned in a single popover plus the Layers list.

videos.title: More menu on tablet
videos.desc: Same content, positioned as a popover next to the rail.

videos.title: Long-press radial menu
videos.desc: Hold a finger on any shape for half a second, Duplicate / Hide / Group / Delete.

videos.title: Touch handle sizing
videos.desc: Resize handles scale up 1.6x on coarse pointer so fingertips can hit them.

videos.title: Two-finger orbit + pan
videos.desc: Camera control gestures, OrbitControls handles pinch-zoom and two-finger pan natively.

videos.title: Pinch to zoom
videos.desc: Standard pinch gesture on the canvas zooms the camera.

videos.title: PWA install (Chrome / Edge)
videos.desc: Browser address bar shows an install icon, click to add to the Start menu.

videos.title: Add to Home Screen (iOS)
videos.desc: Safari share menu, Add to Home Screen, the icon appears like a native app.

videos.title: Works offline
videos.desc: After a single online visit, the service worker caches the whole app. Airplane mode and BlockBuilder still opens.
